name: swe-lr2e5-max32k
selection: Drop complete training trajectories above the existing full-sequence token threshold; never truncate messages or observations.
experiment: Exploratory lower-learning-rate plus long-trajectory filtering; not a learning-rate-only comparison.
template_policy: Retain the original non-thinking template and preserve_thinking=false. The separately diagnosed empty-think-shell discrepancy is not changed in this candidate.
checkpoint_policy: Train from the original Base, one epoch; retain the final checkpoint without loss-based selection. Do not replace the frozen main experts or AVG64 automatically.
logging: Native TensorBoard scalars are training diagnostics only; entropy is not synthesized.
